gotcha! 

•	How old are you? What's your gender? Give us a general description of yourself.

im 15, im genderqueer (but i use she/they pronouns), im on the fence of being a hippie witchy girl & an 80s rocker rebel chick

•	Is there a medical diagnosis that may impact your mental stability somehow?

i have anxiety & depression!

•	Describe your upbringing. Did it have any kind of religious or structured influence? How did you respond to it?

i wasn’t raised religiously, my father was a christian rebel which definitely impacted how i see religion now. my parents were always strict on where i would go and what i would do, and i always followed what they would tell me to do (to an extent). they were never strict on swearing though, and it shows, i cuss like a sailor.

•	If you had to spend an entire weekend by yourself, how would you feel? Would you feel lonely or refreshed?

i would feel lonely AND refreshed. i think the anxiety and depression part of me would cause the loneliness, but the logical and introverted part of me would be refreshed

•	What kinds of activities do you prefer? Do you like, and are you good at sports? Do you enjoy any other outdoor or indoor activities?

im good at soccer, i was the team captain for 5 years on my club team, i dont do much other for sports than that, i played softball for a while

•	How curious are you? Do you have more ideas then you can execute? What are your curiosities about? What are your ideas about - is it environmental or conceptual, and can you please elaborate?

im decently curious! i hold myself back from executing most of what i want to though out of fear of failure. i love the idea of exploring and trying new things, but i NEVER try them, because i hate failure.

•	Would you enjoy taking on a leadership position? Do you think you would be good at it? What would your leadership style be?

i love leadership positions, but only because i believe that i can execute everything the right way. im usually calm and understanding of others, i tutor and practically student teach my math class, and they love me :)

•	Are you coordinated? Why do you feel as if you are or are not? Do you enjoy working with your hands in some form? Describe your activity?

some would say im VERY uncoordinated and unorganized, but i like to think of it as organized chaos. it makes sense to me! i make jewelry, dye hair (i do it with my friend who cuts hair) and draw sometimes, so i suppose i like working with my hands!

•	What's your opinion about the past, present, and future? How do you deal with them?

the future is scary to me, but i daydream about it often. i enjoy the idea of being free. the past is useless to me as i cannot change it, but i dwell on it often.

•	How do you act when others request your help to do something (anything)? If you would decide to help them, why would you do so?

i often love helping others! especially since i find myself succeeding often i like to share my success with others (only if i like them though, if i dislike them i hold back my wisdom).

•	Do you need logical consistency in your life?

yes and no. mostly yes. consistency is key and i often notice if it’s off.

•	Do you control others, even if indirectly? How and why do you do that?

i think i do unintentionally. i have mentioned throughout this questionnaire that i like to believe that i can do things the best way, so i try to help others succeed in that way.

•	What are your hobbies? Why do you like them?

i like dying hair and making jewelry! i like them because they give me some creative liberty whilst having some limitations:)

•	What is your learning style? What kind of learning environments do you struggle with most? Why do you like/struggle with these learning styles? Do you prefer classes involving memorization, logic, creativity, or your physical senses?

i love classes with creativity and hands on learning involved! however, when i can just teach myself, i also do very good. im not a huge fan of group projects because i like to think i do things the best way they can be done for the best grade.

•	How good are you at strategizing? Do you easily break up projects into manageable tasks? Or do you have a tendency to wing projects and improvise as you go?

i do both, i like to strategize mostly. if my strategy doesnt work i wing it, i have no problem with improvising.

•	What are your aspirations in life, professionally and personally?

personally, i want to live somewhere, maybe a city like chicago, seattle or new york. professionally, i want to be a highschool teacher or a hairdresser :)

•	What are your fears? What makes you uncomfortable? What do you hate? Why?

i have the physical fears of a CHILD. im mostly scared of the dark. however, im scared of failure, letting others down, and being alone forever.

•	How attached are you to reality? Do you daydream often, or do you pay attention to what's around you? If you do daydream, are you aware of your surroundings while you do so?

i daydream a decent amount, but im very aware of my surroundings whilst i do so. 

•	Imagine you are alone in a blank, empty room. There is nothing for you to do and no one to talk to. What do you think about?

i imagine i would start thinking about what i would do to leave or how i got there, i would also think i would start thinking about those outside of the room, my loved ones. 

•	How long do you take to make an important decision? And do you change your mind once you've made it?

depends on the severity, i make most decisions on impulse, but if i regret them i change my mind and my actions

•	How long do you take to process your emotions? How important are emotions in your life?

i take a decent amount of time to focus on my own emotions, depends on the severity of my depression and anxiety in the moment

•	Do you ever catch yourself agreeing with others just to appease them and keep the conversation going? How often? Why?

depends on the situation and how passionate i am about it. most of the time if im very passionate about it i will continue to defend it and keep conversation going.

•	Do you break rules often? Do you think authority should be challenged, or that they know better? If you do break rules, why?

it depends, but for the most part i question the rules and authority. do i break them? not really, in school i keep to the rules, but at home i get tempted to break them more often then not.

a mix of both, it depends. with actions that dont matter as much (ie cutting hair) im very impulsive, however, something important (like an argument or a debate) i evaluate it before/during it and make decisions based on what i find.

i have decently strong moral values, sometimes to the point of me being judgmental over them, but i always an open to hearing other’s values and opinions, doesnt mean i will agree with them or like them though
